reading.review:
Warm, brisk, and full of hearthside charm, The Hobbit is the gold standard of adventure storytelling. Watching Bilbo Baggins grow from a comfort-loving homebody into a resourceful, compassionate burglar is a joy from first page to last.

The riddle game in the dark and the conversation with Smaug remain two of the finest chapters in fantasy literature.

note.note-text: Riddles in the Dark — tense, atmospheric, and quietly pivotal to everything that follows in Middle-earth.
Bilbo's quiet courage at the Lonely Mountain shows how kindness can outweigh greed.
